items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And then I played Pantages circuit with Rosco Ates.

ctx.x: And oh, there were things, we had a lot of, a lot of things happened shortly after I took over the band. We were booked in the Paramount Theater, with the Mills Brothers when they first were beginning. They had been singing, but this was in their early, early days.
We were booked in the Paramount. And then I played Pantages circuit with Rosco Ates. I don't know if you know him or not.
